summary: Added paragraph-based draft version helper primitives and an additive draft_version analysis surface. The new functions build locked paragraph snapshots, compute paragraph-scoped diffs, apply revisions while skipping locked paragraphs, and reconstruct a draft for rollback. This is local deterministic metadata only: no persistence, no frontend UI, no model calls, and no semantic review.
implemented: backend/server.py: added build_draft_version(payload, version_id=None), returning method=draft_version_v1, version_id, paragraph_count, paragraphs, and locked_paragraphs.
backend/server.py: added diff_draft_versions(previous, current), returning method=draft_version_diff_v1, per-index entries, and changed/added/removed/unchanged counts.

backend/server.py: added apply_paragraph_revisions(base_version, revisions, locked_indexes=None), applying valid unlocked paragraph revisions and reporting applied_revisions, skipped_locked, and invalid_revisions without mutating the base version.
backend/server.py: added rollback_draft_version(version), reconstructing draft text from a version and reporting restored_version_id.

No cross-session version store; callers must persist returned versions if needed.

apply_paragraph_revisions preserves locked paragraphs but does not authenticate who locked them.
